body:
**This post is the single authoritative registration of the skills lane's SECOND seat (`domain:skills#2`).** Four-section template; the job description is versioned at `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` — ⛔ not copied here. Seat 1's post is #7623. Body **r37** (standby; serial queue), written 2026-10-15T14:19Z by `session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7` (os-elon-musk); r36, r35, r34, r33 (seating) and r32 (the previous shift's sign-off ledger, `session_012dGTuJen61ECNHXYXKChoC`, os-justin) are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated.

## Current PM

🟢 **os-elon-musk** — `session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7`, seated on the maintainer's `/pm-dispatch skills seat 2` in this session; the round-open marker is the comment stamped after this body. Default wake-up Routine `trig_0146Bbf4fhg7HqoFCFCYGvWw` (hourly at :16, self-bound to this session). Batch **3** (the seating default; no maintainer word on concurrency in this session). Seat 1 (#7623, `session_01GjUZrCo7Yi58T4vPXqx88e`, os-sales) is live on its own batch 1; the two seats split the lane by claim, and each card's newest `Claim:` `Seat:` line says whose it is.

## Inherited + running ledger

- **From r32:** nothing owed. #22978 and #22585 (r32's two `pm:blocked`) were claimed and closed by seat 1; `tracking` 2 (#22060, #17161) unchanged. r32's relay items 3–5 stand as recorded there (the relay-credential rotation question on objectstack-ai/objectui#12212 stays with the maintainer; the two lane-table observations; `check:platform-checklist` is the watchdog's).
- **Lane now** (objectstack; objectui 0 open `domain:skills`): `pm:queue` #23665, unblocked when #23653 closed; its scoped mode is on `main` at `09dd53719`. It is serial behind PR #23676, per note 6194302931 on the card. `pm:blocked` 0. Decision box, `finding`, `pm:on-hold` and `pm:retriage` all 0. Seat 1's #23579 and #23606 landed (PRs #23660, #23668).
- **This seat's cards (R1):**
  - #23615 — **landed**: PR #23669 `547702080`, Tier H, approved and enqueued by `os-zhuang` before the at-tier review could run (tier at its usage limit); landing comment 6192063883.
  - #23662 — ACCEPT on PR #23675 (record 6192322695), Tier S, CI green; **waits only on the at-tier contract review** (`needs:contract-review`).
  - #23607 — ACCEPT on PR #23676 (record 6192430896), Tier S; **waits only on the at-tier contract review** (`needs:contract-review`). Built at `TIER_DEFAULT` under the quota exemption, so the at-tier review is its compensating control.
  - #23606 was lost to seat 1 (yield note on the card).
- **In flight 0 · Landing windows 2** (PRs #23675 and #23676, both review-gated) · **awaiting a human merge 0 · decision box 0**. Posture: standby (empty queue), with the landing windows followed to MERGED.

## Hot-file serial queue

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`: PR #23676 (#23607) → #23665. Serial: fold gate ① fails. #23676 brings the file to 402/402, so #23665's line takes a ruled raise (6190922830 under 6184799323 B). Dispatch #23665 only after #23676 reads MERGED.
- `references/execution-duties.md` and its `CEILINGS` row in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: PR #23676, until it lands.
- `references/decision-analysis.md`: PR #23675 (#23662), until it lands.
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` · `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` · `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`: FROZEN (ruling 208 R6). Every other lane file: FREE.

## Notes

- **Write paths:** content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `issue-create.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (`issue_patch` for this post's title and PR bodies); route `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`, Actions `active`); ⛔ no MCP write.
- **Harness:** STALE at seating (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`, touched by `1ced0f82b`); the shared checkout fast-forwarded `286eb9ef3` → `1ced0f82b` (`--ff-only`), `check-harness-current` now CURRENT. The loaded `SKILL.md` is unchanged since `7b3d5585c`.
- **Served tier:** `get_session` `last_served_model` is the `TIER_DEFAULT` build ⇒ at-tier contract reviews run in an isolated at-tier subagent; ⛔ no self-review above the seat's tier. The seven-day quota reads `allowed_warning`.
- **Temporary deviation (quota wall):**
  - `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` refused this session's at-tier review subagent with HTTP 429 (usage limit reached), reported to the seat by 2026-10-15T12:03Z.
  - Meanwhile, builds with that path mandate fall to `TIER_DEFAULT` (the quota exemption, never lower), and every at-tier contract review waits.
  - **End condition:** the first at-tier subagent call that answers; re-checked at each patrol fire. Refusals since then: 12:41Z, 13:18Z (×2) and 14:18Z (×2). Each reviewer launched on PR #23675 or #23676 was refused HTTP 429 before writing a record; the latest refusals were reported by 2026-10-15T14:18Z.
- **Carried for the shift brief** (not cards, under the filing gate):
  - **Platform fact:** `references/platform-readings.md` L171 documents the single-issue page payload as `payload.preloadedQueries[0].result.data.repository.issue` with `frontTimelineItems`. Measured live by the #23615 dev and by the seat 2026-10-15T11:59Z: the `react-app.embeddedData` block carrying `bodyHTML` holds `payload.issueViewerRoute.data.repository.issue`, with `timelineItems` / `backTimelineItems`.
  - **Principle:** `SKILL.md` L265 「…四轴冲突时其余各轴合起来投不翻它」 names no axis-④ new-gate exception, now that `decision-analysis.md` does (PR #23675). The #23662 dev reads L266 as reconciling the two.
  - **Principle:** `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`'s report JSON template has no `deviations` key, while three of its lines (one new, from PR #23676) and the dispatch orders name one.
- **Timers and subscriptions:** Routine `trig_0146Bbf4fhg7HqoFCFCYGvWw`; no `send_later`; `subscribe_pr_activity` on PRs #23675 and #23676 (PR #23669 ended at its merge); each further PR is subscribed the moment its report names it. Worktrees: the devs' own.
